title: Unrelated business income — Riverside Arts Center
instructions: Riverside Arts Center is a §501(c)(3) public charity organized as a corporation. Classify each activity, then compute its 2025 unrelated business taxable income and tax.

exhibits.title: 2025 activities
exhibits.content:
1. A gift shop selling donated items, staffed by volunteers: net income $35,000.
2. A parking lot operated for the public on weekends: gross receipts $60,000, directly connected expenses $20,000.
3. Dividends on its endowment: $25,000.
4. Rent from a building it bought with borrowed money and leases to an unrelated business: rent $50,000, directly connected expenses $20,000; average acquisition debt $300,000; average adjusted basis $600,000.
5. A corporate sponsor's payment that receives only an acknowledgment of its name and logo: $30,000.
6. Paid advertising in its monthly magazine: income $20,000, direct expenses $12,000 (no readership costs exceed circulation income).

rows.label: 1. Donated-goods gift shop run by volunteers
rows.explanation: Sales of donated goods and volunteer-run activities are excluded.

rows.label: 2. Public parking lot
rows.explanation: Operating a parking lot for the public is a trade or business, not passive rent.

rows.label: 3. Endowment dividends
rows.explanation: Dividends are passive income excluded under §512(b)(1).

rows.label: 4. Debt-financed rental building
rows.explanation: Debt-financed property income is UBTI in proportion to acquisition debt.

rows.label: 5. Qualified sponsorship payment
rows.explanation: Acknowledgment without qualitative advertising is a qualified sponsorship payment.

rows.label: 6. Magazine advertising
rows.explanation: Selling advertising is an unrelated trade or business.
